description: Hard, block, layout and soft constraints for the school timetable solver.

mandatoryHard.name: No Teacher Double Booking
mandatoryHard.description: A teacher cannot teach two sections in the same day and period.

mandatoryHard.name: Teacher Availability
mandatoryHard.description: Teachers cannot be assigned on their off-days or unavailable periods. Empty availability means fully available.

mandatoryHard.name: One Lesson Per Section Slot
mandatoryHard.description: Every active section must have exactly one lesson in each teaching period.

mandatoryHard.name: No Lesson During Break
mandatoryHard.description: No lesson can be assigned during short breaks or lunch breaks.

mandatoryHard.name: Consecutive Subject Blocks
mandatoryHard.description: Subjects requiring two or more periods per day should be scheduled in consecutive pairs.

mandatoryHard.name: Subject Day Restrictions
mandatoryHard.description: Subjects must follow their configured allowed and restricted days.

mandatoryHard.name: Daily Subject Limit
mandatoryHard.description: A subject cannot exceed its maximum periods per day.

mandatoryHard.name: Weekly Subject Quota
mandatoryHard.description: Each subject must receive its required weekly periods.

mandatoryHard.name: Fixed Activity Slots
mandatoryHard.description: Activities with fixed day and period must be scheduled at those exact slots.

mandatoryHard.name: Exclude Zero Workload
mandatoryHard.description: Assignments with zero weekly workload must not be scheduled.

mandatoryHard.name: Formal Teacher Assignment
mandatoryHard.description: Use the teacher assigned in the official section-level teacher allocation data.

mandatoryHard.name: Unassigned Teacher Rows
mandatoryHard.description: Do not schedule unassigned teacher rows. Report them as data conflicts.

blockAndLayout.name: Consecutive Period Pair
blockAndLayout.description: A double-period block must occupy adjacent teaching periods without a break between them.

blockAndLayout.name: No Orphan Block
blockAndLayout.description: A block requiring two periods must not be scheduled as a single isolated period.

blockAndLayout.name: Pair Single Period Subjects
blockAndLayout.description: Two single-period subjects may be placed in adjacent periods.

blockAndLayout.name: Different Subject Pairing
blockAndLayout.description: Do not pair subjects that share the same first word.

blockAndLayout.name: Daily and Weekly Caps
blockAndLayout.description: Never exceed configured daily or weekly subject limits.

layoutRules.name: Same First Word Subjects
layoutRules.description: Subjects with the same first word must not be scheduled on the same day.

layoutRules.name: Avoid Same Subject Across Break
layoutRules.description: Do not schedule the same subject in the last teaching period before a break and the first teaching period after that break.

layoutRules.name: Maximum Consecutive Subject Periods
layoutRules.description: A subject cannot occupy more than three consecutive teaching periods.

activityRules.name: Games and Library Not First Pair

optional.name: Room Type Matching
optional.description: Computer subjects require a Computer Lab; Science subjects require a Science Lab.

optional.name: No Room Double Booking
optional.description: A room cannot be assigned to two sections in the same time slot.

optional.name: Merged Section Scheduling
optional.description: Sections sharing a merged subject may use the same master timetable slots.

optional.name: Pre Primary Exclusion
optional.description: Optional production rule. Assessment mode currently retains all 41 sections.

deferred.name: Substitution Eligibility
deferred.description: Teacher substitution eligibility is outside the current assessment scope.

deferred.name: Substitution Assignment
deferred.description: Automatic substitution assignment is outside the current assessment scope.

deferred.name: Heuristic Force Fill
deferred.description: The CP-SAT solver should use feasibility and objective optimization instead of heuristic force-fill passes.
